panels.title: Embedding Outcomes (retries collapsed)
panels.description: One row per logical embedding operation, whatever it cost in attempts. This is what the EmbeddingOperationsFailing alert reads: a failure here means a caller went without its vector, not merely that a retry happened.

panels.title: Embedding Shaper Outcomes
panels.description: What the rate shaper did per attempt. A rising "expired" means the shaper is holding and EMBEDDING_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_CALLS — with the provider quota behind it — needs raising for the current number of users. A rising "unavailable" means Redis is down and nothing is being shaped at all.

panels.title: Embedding Provider Errors by reason
panels.description: WHY the provider refused an attempt, classified exactly as the retry classifies it: http_429 is the quota, http_500/503 the provider itself, message:* a transient read from the message when no status code travelled, permanent a refusal that retrying cannot fix (malformed input, invalid key). This is the series the incident diagnosis reads so it never has to say "no error log is provided".

panels.title: Cost saved by LLM cache (24h)

panels.title: Cost saved (by model / currency)
panels.description: Estimated provider cost avoided by LLM cache hits. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: Pricing cache fallbacks (by reason)
panels.description: Cost computations that fell back because the in-memory pricing cache had no row for the model. Sustained fallbacks mean unpriced usage. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).
